title: What if Humans Are NOT Earth's First Civilization? | Silurian Hypothesis
summary: PBS Space Time examines the Silurian hypothesis, the idea that an industrial civilization could have existed on Earth before humans. It looks at what traces such a civilization might leave in the geological record.
why: HN uses it as an approachable treatment of whether an earlier industrial civilization would be detectable in geology.

quote.text: This youtube video addresses the situation pretty well
